definitions.explanation: The state of being late or behind in paying debts, rent, or other financial obligations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{延滞|えんたい}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{延滞|えんたい}{金|きん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
{支払|しはら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{延滞|えんたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Continued late payments affect your credit.

notes:
{延滞|えんたい} refers to being late or behind on a financial obligation such as rent, loan payments, or taxes. A compound of {延|えん} (extend, delay) + {滞|たい} (stagnate).

COMPOUNDS:
- {延滞|えんたい}{金|きん} / {延滞|えんたい}{料|りょう}: late fee, penalty
- {延滞|えんたい}⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧: delinquency interest
- {延滞|えんたい}⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧: number of days overdue
- {延滞|えんたい}{税|ぜい}: delinquency tax

USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb ({延滞|えんたい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Common in financial, rental, and legal contexts. Continued {延滞|えんたい} can affect one's ⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (credit record).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {延滞|えんたい}: being overdue, in arrears (the state of lateness)
- ⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧: nonpayment, default (stronger — implies willful failure to pay)
- {未払|みはら}い: unpaid (neutral description of payment status)
